  (function() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('ehGrid');
    if (!grid) return;
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var cells = Array.prototype.filter.call(grid.children, function(el) {
      return el.className.indexOf('eh-cell-known') === -1;
    });
    setInterval(function() {
      for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        var el = cells[Math.floor(Math.random() * cells.length)];
        el.classList.add('eh-cell-flash');
        (function(e) { setTimeout(function() { e.classList.remove('eh-cell-flash'); }, 900); })(el);
      }
    }, 1200);
  })();
  </script>
